nodes.label: ADR-016 — Tela de operação: faceplate + tendência com predição do MPC

Decision: per-MPC operation screen — main faceplate (modes/status/commands), small faceplates per variable, central uPlot trend with prediction overlay from now; predictions published on mpc.state.* and never persisted
nodes.rationale: Operating an MPC requires seeing past (history) and future (prediction) — the APC console pattern. Only the latest prediction matters, so the runtime publishes prediction vectors on the bus each solve and history comes from the hypertable/continuous aggregate; uPlot handles realtime plus future-axis overlay.
